topic: Week 3 recap: 6 more Claude lessons for beginners in 60 seconds
post:
Three weeks of learning Claude. Still no tech background needed. 🎓
Here's everything from week 3, in 60 seconds.

1️⃣ What's a "model"?
It's the AI brain behind the chat. Haiku is fastest, Sonnet balances speed and smarts, Opus and Fable handle the heaviest work.

2️⃣ Tidy your Downloads with Cowork
Share ONLY that folder, say "don't delete anything", and review the plan first.

3️⃣ Claude Code isn't just for code
Point it at a folder of notes and ask for every action item assigned to you.

4️⃣ The "interview me first" prompt
Ask Claude to ask YOU up to 5 questions, one at a time, before it starts.

5️⃣ Skills
Teach Claude a repeat task once, and it does it your way every time.

6️⃣ Read before you click
Claude Code asks before it acts. Read the pop-up, and use /rewind to undo Claude's edits.

Why it matters:
Week 3 was about handing Claude real work, on your own files, while you keep the steering wheel. 🧭

Your challenge this week: build one Skill for a task you repeat every week.

Which lesson will you try first? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
